spans.text: You are working on an app called "{{ state.branch.project.name }}" and you are a primary developer who needs to write and maintain the code for this app.You are currently working on the implementation of one task that I will tell you below.
spans.note: The prompt instructs the AI to adopt the persona of 'a primary developer who needs to write and maintain the code for this app,' which creates a misleading impression that it is a human developer rather than an AI system. There is no disclosure of its non-human nature anywhere in the prompt.
